description: Retrieves all published component sets from the specified Figma main file (file_key must not be for a branch).

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving component sets from a specific Figma file.

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file. Must be a main file key (not a branch key) as component sets are published from main files. Extract from Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/...
file_key.title: File Key
